title: CoT display convention
description: How one run draws each vehicle population in Cursor-on-Target: the affiliation letter a TAK client colors its tracks by. A choice about display, not part of the scenario: kept beside the scenario as <scenario>.display.json, and read by carla-cot-telemetry. It names populations and never single vehicles.

convention_version.description: The format version of this file. A reader refuses any other.

description.description: What the convention is for, in a sentence or two. Not read.

affiliation_by_type.description: Each population's affiliation: the second letter of a CoT type. A population is a vehicle class id (a vType's carla:class_id) in a compiled scenario, or a vType id in a hand-written route file. A population left out takes the run's default.
